java.lang.Object

  • Method Details

    • applyDefaults

      public static void applyDefaults()
      Sets look-and-feel defaults for every panel. Call once on the Swing thread before any component is created: plain (not bold) text, soft grid lines and a light-green selection.

    • styleTable

      public static void styleTable(JTable table)
      Common table setup: comfortable rows, a white background below the last row and fixed column order.

    • primary

      public static void primary(JButton button)
      Marks the main action of a panel, such as Add or Submit, in the brand green.
